skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic accounting principles and practices specific to insurance enterprises.
Prepare financial reports according to regulatory standards for insurance companies.
Accurately account for short-term assets including cash, investments, receivables, and other short-term assets.
Manage long-term asset accounting including fixed assets and long-term investments.
Handle capital source accounting including borrowed funds and equity.
Record revenue from insurance operations, financial activities, and other sources.
Track expenses related to insurance operations, financial activities, and other areas.
Determine business profitability through accurate accounting practices.
